title: Rebel 1100 DCT (Track Edition)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Honda Rebel 1100 DCT (Track Edition) is born on the race grid to deliver uncompromised high-speed aerodynamic downforce. At its heart lies a 1100cc powertrain delivering 154 HP and 123 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 228 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Upright Neutral posture paired with an accessible 705mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights, backed by a 19.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
